description: H_aleph-one is a proper subset of V_omega-one: omega belongs to H_aleph-one but its power set does not, although that power set has rank omega+1 and belongs to V_omega-one.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.HereditaryCardinality.hereditaryCountable_strict_hierarchy.{u} :
  Lemmatheca.SetTheory.HereditaryCardinality.hereditaryLevel (Cardinal.aleph 1) ⊂ ZFSet.vonNeumann (Ordinal.omega 1) ∧
    Ordinal.omega0.toZFSet ∈ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.HereditaryCardinality.hereditaryLevel (Cardinal.aleph 1) ∧
      Ordinal.omega0.toZFSet.powerset ∉ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.HereditaryCardinality.hereditaryLevel (Cardinal.aleph 1) ∧
        Ordinal.omega0.toZFSet.powerset.rank = Ordinal.omega0 + 1 ∧
          Ordinal.omega0.toZFSet.powerset ∈ ZFSet.vonNeumann (Ordinal.omega 1)
